source_clock_roles: original source station-owned hour ordinals, chronological legitimate observed events only; metadata from measured source, no target oracle
source_train_window: March 1–April 17 2014 publisher measured source records; original normalization exclusively before 2014-03-01
source_evaluation_window: May 1–June 9 2014 source previously viewed by prior TAC research, DEVELOPMENT ONLY
base_model: SourceAlignedParallelWorld 98326 genuinely live parameters, 410 retained FP32 source state per independent stream plus owner/last ordinal and base metadata
control_semantics: same full original network, same 256-FP32 extra stored memory and identical trainable parameters; only final known-ordinal query points at prior adjacent *wrong* recorded event. This isolates source-specific addressing, NOT absence of all memory.
frozen_origin: both arms for each seed initialized from SAME exact 2014-source-trained 96639 parameter PAR-TIME-005 backbone checkpoint plus identically seeded new memory head
source_site_sampling: four distinct sites per fit step, selected using seeded PRNG and registered before training; no target-label based sampling
source_loss: SmoothL1 of predicted genuine previously observed source PM2.5 at requested event + 0.15 times source-normalized masked next-clock-hour physical score after anchor
head_next_outcome_source_legality: next-clock-hour measured physical target used only in training loss AFTER all anchor input observations; no future target is exposed as input or query key
optimizer: torch AdamW foreach=false fused=false FP32; learning_rate=0.0005 weight_decay=0.001 grad clip norm 1
primary_metric: normalized historic measured PM2.5 MAE by lag and seed, paired on exact same real source anchor, source current-copy baseline and true full external record oracle clearly privileged
secondary_metric: normalized physically measured next-hour PM2.5 MAE by source per anchor, no statistical claim on previously exposed DEV
full_mathematical_train_operator_FLOP_pa: NOT YET CERTIFIED; same network, source events, batch tensor shapes and optimizer steps and operations; operator trace must be compared end-to-end, unsupported operations and data-dependent backend ignored by approximate profiler
